card.name: Optional plural "(s)" after nouns
card.fires_on: The "(s" piece of an optional-plural marker like "Drug(s)" written right after a singular noun. It appears in tables, headings and instructions.

modes.label: Table headings
modes.description: Optional plural after a column or heading noun such as Drug or Effect.
modes.example: Drug Class Drug<<(s>>) within Class Effect on Drug Concentration

modes.label: Instruction text
modes.description: Optional plural after a noun in a step or sentence.
modes.example: Expel air bubble<<(s>>). Adjust the dose (if applicable).
